lead: S. Sreesanth is best known as an Indian cricketer, born on 6 February 1983 in Kothamangalam.
As of 2026, he is 43 years old, and his birth date places him under the Aquarius sign.
He has represented India national cricket team and Kerala cricket team.
The sections that follow break down S. Sreesanth's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.

sections.heading: S. Sreesanth — Career and Professional Work
paras: S. Sreesanth works primarily as a cricketer.

On the team sheet, S. has been associated with India national cricket team (from 2006 to 2011), Kerala cricket team (from 2002 to 2013), Punjab Kings (from 2008 to 2010), Warwickshire County Cricket Club (from 2009 to 2009), Kochi Tuskers Kerala (from 2011 to 2011) and Rajasthan Royals.
